# MoRoundButton

The 40pt round button and the 36pt action chip that every phone screen is built from.

`OmniOSDesignSystem_a7120f.MoRoundButton` · 14 Phone

## Use

```jsx
<OmniOSDesignSystem_a7120f.MoRoundButton icon="…" label="…" />
```

```html
<x-import component-from-global-scope="OmniOSDesignSystem_a7120f.MoRoundButton" icon="…" label="…"></x-import>
```

## Notes

Phone buttons. Same props on web (MoButtons.jsx) and Expo (native/MoButtons.tsx). MoRoundButton: 40pt round; default surface-2, ink = the one primary action (send, stop), quiet = no fill on a surface. MoActionChip: 36pt pill for this thread's next step; needs = an answer to a question. @startingPoint section="Phone" subtitle="Round buttons and action chips" viewport="860x180"

| `label` * | `string` | Accessible label; also the tooltip on web. |
| `onPress` | `() => void` |  |
| `tone` | `'default' \| 'ink' \| 'quiet'` |  |
| `size` | `number` | 40 by default; 32 inside sheets. Hit area stays 44pt on Expo. |
| `disabled` | `boolean` |  |
